Signature keynote

The Cost of SilenceFrom Avoidance to Accountability

For: Teams, leaders, and professional groups.

Everyone knows something needs to be said, but no one wants to say it first. Vivian shows how that hesitation shapes the decisions people make together and what can change when someone raises a concern early.

What audiences take away

  • Recognize when unspoken assumptions are making a shared decision harder.
  • Use an opening line to raise a concern without putting someone on the defensive.
  • Identify one next step and who can take responsibility for it.

Financial Infidelity and Our Emotional Relationship With Money

For: Couples, relationship-focused groups, and financial-wellness audiences.

A hidden purchase or an unopened statement can be a sign that money feels too difficult to talk about. Vivian explores how fear, shame, and old habits contribute to secrecy and how partners can begin to talk about it.

What audiences take away

  • Notice patterns of avoidance and secrecy before they become harder to address.
  • Identify what makes a money topic difficult to raise with a partner.
  • Leave with a question that can open a conversation without blame.

What your audience can take back with them

Give people a shared way to talk about what they’ve been avoiding. They’ll leave with language they can use when a concern comes up at work or a decision about money needs to be made at home.
